_comment: W1-T2926 — the recorded SET of COMMANDS verbs with no console route, each carrying a stated reason in scripts/console-parity-ratchet.mjs's CLI_ONLY table. It may SHRINK (a verb gaining a route, or leaving COMMANDS entirely) and must never grow without this file being edited in the same PR: a verb added to CLI_ONLY that is absent here reddens the 'console-parity' step in ci.yml's comment-load-ratchet job. Captured 2026-09-10 against COMMANDS/declaredConsoleRoutes() as they stood when W1-T2926 landed — 62 of 76 verbs. This is a ceiling on the SET, not a target: several entries (serve, daemon, deploy, sync, doctor, console-url, ...) are host/process-local by nature and may never shrink; most of the rest are shrinkable by routing the verb, per this task's own follow-up list.
